message:
The other day, I was rummaging through the closet when I stumbled upon an old suitcase. I opened it, half expecting to find memories of trips long past, but instead, I found just a jumble of mismatched socks and a few dusty travel brochures. It made me chuckle—here I was, thinking of my go-bag, and I couldn't even manage a well-packed suitcase! 

It reminded me that preparedness doesn't have to be perfect; it's about making an effort. Even a little planning can save us from a comedy of errors when the unexpected happens. Have you ever found yourself in a similar situation?
